 Dividend alert: MRF, Cochin Shipyard, Talbros and others may reward shareholders this week - Check key dates, returns
 MRF, Cochin Shipyard, Nile Limited, Talbros Automotive Components and EAAA India are scheduled to report Q2 FY27 results next week and may announce dividends. 
 TALBROAUTO COCHINSHIP DIVIDEND NILE Sharmila Bhadoria Published 8 Nov 2026, 10:00 PM IST Prefer Livemint on Google Check upcoming dividend announcements expected next week (AI image for representational purpose) Dividend alert: Shares of MRF, Cochin Shipyard , EAAA India and Talbros Automotive Components are likely to remain in focus in the coming week as these companies are scheduled to announce their second-quarter results for FY27. Investors will also track their board meetings for potential dividend announcements. 
 As the corporate earnings season reached to its last leg, Nifty and Sensex are likely to remain volatile in the coming week after the market ended flat in Diwali’s Muhurat trading session on Sunday, November 8. Nifty 50 failed to retain the 25,000 levels and ended 0.18% lower, whereas BSE Sensex closed 28.62 points lower. 
 As investors prepare for the next week’s trading session, here are all the details to know. 
 Dividend alert: Companies expected to announce dividend this week 
 MRF, Cochin Shipyard, Nile Limited, Talbros Automotive Components, and EAA India are scheduled to announce their Q2FY27 results next week. They may also announce dividend. 
 Company Name 
 Expected Announcement Date 
 Corporate Purpose 
 MRF Ltd 10 November 2026 Quarterly Financial Results, Interim Dividend 
 Cochin Shipyard Ltd 10 November 2026 Quarterly Financial Results, Interim Dividend 
 Nile Ltd 10 November 2026 Quarterly Financial Results, Interim Dividend 
 Talbros Automotive Components Ltd 11 November 2026 Quarterly Financial Results, Interim Dividend 
 EAAA India 11 November Quarterly Financial Results, Interim dividend 
 MRF Limited 
 MRF share price closed 1.11% higher at ₹ 1,26,699.85 per share on BSE on Sunday, November 8. The stock has delivered negative 20.25% return in one year, 6.22% return in two years, and 16.92% return in three years. 
 Cochin Shipyard 
 Shares of Cochin Shipyard closed 1.48% higher at ₹ 1238 per share on BSE with a market capitalisation of ₹ 32,569.40 crore on Friday. The stock has delivered 3% return in one month, but has declined 28.29% in one year, and 14.59% in two years. 
 Nile Limited 
 Nile share price ended 6.12% higher at ₹ 1397.25 per share on BSE with an MCap of ₹ 419.44 crore. The stock has surged 14.26% in one year, but declined 19.47% in one year. 
 Talbros Automotive 
 The company scrip closed Diwali Muhurat trading session with 2.07% gain at ₹ 386.45 per share. The stock has delivered 12% return in two weeks and around 33.33% return in one year. 
 EAAA India 
 The company share price closed 1.31% lower at ₹ 1665.5 per share on BSE with an MCap of ₹ 10,769.30 crore on Friday. The stock has delivered -3.92% in 2026 so far.
